meta.title: dsh-argp
meta.description: Context compaction for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): deterministic label-addressed eviction of tool results (0 LLM), prose condensation only inside compaction transactions (double-gated), label-addressed recall of originals from the append-only log (command/scope escape channels included), and an optional compaction-threshold setting (off by default — a wall hit triggers compaction as the fallback; turn it on to compact before sending at a ratio you choose).
